additional_info.subject: ID0404950-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / S9 313875948001] REWE -Screen Black & Unresponsive CRM:00798001853
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
Issue of Screen Black and Unresponsible have been reported.
We need to plan for the site intervention.
In order to address the issue of Black screen, Instructions are as follow:
Firstly, We need to check if 24v and 0v are available.
if 24v and 0v are absent,
For 24 v, We need to check if the XD23, XD8 and XD21 connections are tight and tidy as per following schematic. Also need to check if FC14 is tripped. (You can share the photo)
For 0 v, We need to check XD22, XD4 connections are tight and tidy.
Also, We need to check if QA25 is tripped.
In case of 24v & 0v are found to be fine, We need to check if there is issue with the DP cable and USB as in the first image.
We need to have spare DP cable and USB cable while intervention.
Also, We need to investiagte as mentioned in the Following QFeedbacks.
http://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/ww/en/view/109816643,
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/ww/en/view/109816666
After analysis and DLogic FW update, if Issue still persists, We need to consider replacing the HMI.
We recommend having spare HMI while Site intervention.
Do let us know in advance if you need assistance in the site intervention.
